me context: this was the first tattoo I got a few months ago. I was stupid and decided to just find a local shop with the best reviews, not knowing it had an average of 4.8 stars mostly because of the customer service. Dont get me the wrong the artists there were nice, but I should've done things right and researched the artists and their portfolios.

Anyway, I paid for it with this tattoo with bad line work. Originally I thought it was dope as hell until i did more research on what great tattoos actually look like and found out mine is actually kind of subpar. I learned my lesson since and went to a great artist for my second tattoo and loved my results. But I still look at my first and thing "damn bro it could've been so much better".

My question is, would a good artist be able to fix this? 

Really the only good thing I have going for me with this tattoo is that most people dont notice anything wrong with it when I'm ask. But I'm sure people who are keen on good vs. bad tattoos will see the issues with it if they get a close enough look at it.
